title: Cloud vs. on-premise large language models for urgent patient-portal message screening: a comparative evaluation
zh_title: 云端与本地大模型筛查患者门户紧急消息对比
summary: 在三个队列中比较六种大模型与医师标准，用于患者门户紧急消息分诊。
key_points: 500条基层消息加503条癫痫门诊消息，及300条外部平台消息
基层队列多数裁定下GPT-5未漏诊紧急消息

reason: 同行评审且有机构外队列外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Patient portal messaging carries a substantial share of outpatient communication, and rising message volume has slowed clinical response to urgent concerns embedded in routine traffic. Whether large language models (LLMs) can triage these messages, and whether locally hosted open-weight models can match cloud-hosted ones, remains unclear. We evaluated six LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Llama 4 Scout, GPT-OSS 20B, Gemma 3 27B) against a physician reference standard in three cohorts: 500 primary care messages enriched for urgent cases, 503 epilepsy clinic messages from the same health system, and 300 patient-authored messages from public platforms outside it. Under Majority adjudication in primary care, GPT-5 missed no urgent message, and four of six models, including one deployable on-premises, reached sensitivity 0.97 or higher and negative predictive value 0.98 or higher. Rank ordering held across cohorts. Both cloud-hosted and on-premise LLMs can rule out urgent messages with high sensitivity, though specificity remained limited.
zh_abstract: 患者门户消息在门诊沟通中占据相当大的份额，而消息量的上升已放缓临床对常规信息流中紧急关切的响应。大型语言模型（LLMs）能否对这些消息进行分诊，以及本地托管的开放权重模型能否与云端托管模型匹敌，仍不清楚。我们在三个队列中对照医师参考标准评估了六种 LLM（GPT-4o、GPT-5、GPT-5 Mini、Llama 4 Scout、GPT-OSS 20B、Gemma 3 27B）：500 条针对紧急病例富集的基层医疗消息、来自同一医疗系统的 503 条癫痫门诊消息，以及来自该系统之外公共平台的 300 条患者撰写消息。在基层医疗的多数裁决下，GPT-5 未漏掉任何紧急消息，六种模型中有四种（包括一种可本地部署的模型）达到灵敏度 0.97 或更高、阴性预测值 0.98 或更高。排序在各队列中保持一致。云端托管和本地部署的 LLM 均能以高灵敏度排除紧急消息，但特异性仍然有限。

title: Tele-Cranio: a CT-free AI solution for remote diagnosis and planning of craniomaxillofacial deformities

summary: 基于手机2D面部照片重建3D面形并估计骨骼形态，辅助颅颌面畸形远程评估与术后模拟。

abstract: Computed tomography (CT) is central to craniomaxillofacial (CMF) deformity care, yet dependence on in-hospital imaging constrains remote preoperative assessment and outcome visualization, and repeated imaging can increase radiation and access burdens, particularly for children. We developed Tele-Cranio, a telemedicine-oriented artificial intelligence framework that uses mobile-acquired 2D facial photographs to reconstruct 3D facial morphology, estimate corresponding skeletal morphology and support postoperative facial simulation conditioned on surgeon-defined skeletal plans. Tele-Cranio was developed using 539 paired multimodal samples comprising 2D facial photographs, 3D facial scans and CT-derived skeletal models from individuals aged 3–60 years, including 334 patients with CMF deformities across malocclusion, cleft lip with/without palate, hemifacial microsomia and rare anomalies. Its core model, the Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity, learns a shared anatomical representation linking facial soft tissue and skeletal structures across normal and pathological morphology. For remote assessment, Tele-Cranio converts facial photographs into 3D facial surfaces and then infers 3D patient-specific skeletal geometry. For simulation, it generates individualized 3D postoperative facial previews after clinicians complete skeletal planning using standard clinical tools. Validated across heterogeneous CMF subgroups, Tele-Cranio provides an interpretable CT-free layer for remote triage, pre-CT consultation, radiation-free follow-up and surgeon–patient communication, while complementing rather than replacing CT-based definitive diagnosis and operative planning.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）在颅颌面（craniomaxillofacial, CMF）畸形诊疗中处于核心地位，但依赖院内成像限制了远程术前评估和结果可视化，反复成像会增加辐射和可及性负担，尤其对儿童。我们开发了Tele-Cranio，一个面向远程医疗的人工智能框架，利用移动设备采集的2D面部照片重建3D面部形态，估计相应骨骼形态，并支持以外科医生定义的骨骼方案为条件的术后面部模拟。Tele-Cranio使用539对配对多模态样本开发，这些样本包括来自3–60岁个体的2D面部照片、3D面部扫描和CT衍生骨骼模型，其中包括334例CMF畸形患者，涵盖错颌畸形、伴/不伴腭裂的唇裂、半侧颜面短小和罕见异常。其核心模型Bidirectional Craniomaxillofacial Model-Deformity学习一个共享解剖表征，将正常和病理形态下的面部软组织与骨骼结构联系起来。对于远程评估，Tele-Cranio将面部照片转换为3D面部表面，然后推断3D患者特异性骨骼几何。对于模拟，它在临床医生使用标准临床工具完成骨骼规划后生成个体化3D术后面部预览。在异质性CMF亚组中验证，Tele-Cranio提供一个可解释的无CT层，用于远程分诊、CT前会诊、无辐射随访和医患沟通，同时补充而非替代基于CT的明确诊断和手术规划。

title: Virtual atrial fibrillation dynamics reflect clinical outcomes after catheter ablation
zh_title: 虚拟房颤动力学可反映消融术后临床结局
summary: 基于323例患者高密度电解剖图构建左房数字孪生，虚拟诱导房颤的可持续性及恢复模式可分层预测消融后房性心律失常复发。
key_points: 323例重构左房数字孪生，虚拟起搏诱导房颤
识别四种恢复模式，Overall-Low复发风险更低(aHR 0.37)

reason: 同行评审、样本可观并报告临床复发结局，但为单队列建模验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Chamber-wide assessment of restitution dynamics is not feasible in vivo during atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. We reconstructed left-atrial digital twins from high-density (HD) bipolar electroanatomical maps in 323 patients, computed node-level restitution steepness (maximal restitution slope [Smax]; >0.4 million nodes), and induced virtual AF with standardized ramp pacing to classify sustainability (sustained ≥16 s vs non-sustained <16 s), excluding 32 cases with extensive low-voltage substrate and depressed mean Smax. We found that clustering of HD restitution profiles identifies four restitution patterns that stratify clinical atrial arrhythmia recurrence, with the Overall-Low pattern (aHR, 0.37) and the Average-Homogeneous pattern (aHR, 0.59) each showing lower risk than the Overall-High pattern. Furthermore, non-sustained virtual AF independently predicted lower recurrence (aHR: 0.27). Adding restitution pattern and sustainability to clinical covariates improved discrimination (ΔHarrell’s C-index: 0.050), and the combined digital-twin model remained incremental after adjustment for low-voltage area burden, supporting digital-twin outputs as complementary functional descriptors for risk stratification after pulmonary vein isolation.
zh_abstract: 在心房颤动（AF）消融过程中，于体内进行全腔恢复动力学评估不可行。我们从323例患者的高密度（HD）双极电解剖标测图中重建左心房数字孪生，计算节点水平恢复陡度（最大恢复斜率[Smax]；>40万个节点），并用标准化斜坡起搏诱导虚拟AF，以对可持续性进行分类（持续≥16 s vs 非持续<16 s），排除了32例具有广泛低电压基质和平均Smax降低的病例。我们发现，HD恢复谱聚类识别出四种恢复模式，可对临床房性心律失常复发进行分层，其中整体-低模式（aHR，0.37）和平均-均质模式（aHR，0.59）均显示出比整体-高模式更低的风险。此外，非持续性虚拟AF独立预测较低的复发风险（aHR：0.27）。将恢复模式和可持续性加入临床协变量后改善了判别能力（ΔHarrell's C-index：0.050），并且在调整低电压面积负荷后，联合数字孪生模型仍具有增量价值，支持数字孪生输出作为肺静脉隔离后风险分层的补充功能描述指标。

title: Epidemiology-informed graph neural networks for predicting and interpreting transmissible hospital-acquired infections
zh_title: 流行病学信息引导的图神经网络预测院内传播性感染
summary: npj Digital Medicine 提出将机制流行病学模型与图神经网络结合的 EIGNN 框架，用于动态医院环境下的患者状态转移预测与参数估计。

abstract: Transmissible hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) arise from complex, time-varying interactions among patients, healthcare workers, and clinical environments. Although data-driven approaches like graph neural networks (GNNs) effectively model these contacts, they often function as black boxes that overlook established epidemiological principles, limiting interpretability and clinical trust. Inspired by physics-informed neural networks, we propose an epidemiology-informed GNN (EIGNN) framework for patient-level state transitions prediction in dynamic hospital settings, integrating mechanistic epidemiological models into GNNs in a principled manner. Patient-level risk factors learned from dynamic contact networks are jointly leveraged to infer latent epidemiological states, predict state transitions across multiple horizons, and estimate key epidemiological parameters, including transmission and recovery rates. We evaluate the approach on a real-world hospital-onset COVID-19 cohort and two public datasets simulating viral and bacterial HAIs. Across multiple architectures and horizons, EIGNNs achieves AUC-ROC up to 98.46% while providing interpretable, mechanistically consistent insights, offering a transparent tool for infection prevention and control.
zh_abstract: 可传播的医院获得性感染（HAIs）源于患者、医护人员和临床环境之间复杂的、随时间变化的相互作用。尽管图神经网络（GNNs）等数据驱动方法能有效建模这些接触，但它们常作为黑箱运行，忽视已建立的流行病学原理，限制了可解释性和临床信任。受物理信息神经网络启发，我们提出一种流行病学信息引导的GNN（EIGNN）框架，用于动态医院环境中的患者级状态转移预测，以有原则的方式将机制性流行病学模型整合到GNNs中。从动态接触网络中学习到的患者级风险因素被联合利用，以推断潜在流行病学状态、预测多个时间跨度上的状态转移，并估计关键流行病学参数，包括传播率和恢复率。我们在一个真实世界医院发病COVID-19队列和两个模拟病毒性与细菌性HAIs的公共数据集上评估该方法。在多种架构和时间跨度上，EIGNNs达到高达98.46%的AUC-ROC，同时提供可解释、机制一致的洞见，为感染预防与控制提供透明工具。

title: Shape-informed cardiac mechanics surrogates in data-scarce regimes via geometric encoding and generative augmentation
zh_title: 几何编码与生成增强的数据稀缺心脏力学替代模型
summary: 同行评审：两步框架将左心室几何表征与物理响应学习解耦，用生成合成几何增强稀缺数据下的力学替代建模。
key_points: 形状模型学习左心室几何的紧凑潜表征

reason: 方法新颖的同行评审研究，但属计算仿真替代模型，验证范围有限
abstract: High-fidelity computational models of cardiac mechanics provide mechanistic insight into the heart function but are computationally prohibitive for routine clinical use. Surrogate models can accelerate simulations, but generalization across diverse anatomies is challenging, particularly in data-scarce settings. We propose a two-step framework that decouples geometric representation from learning the physics response, to enable shape-informed surrogate modeling under data-scarce conditions. First, a shape model learns a compact latent representation of left ventricular geometries. The learned latent space effectively encodes anatomies and enables synthetic geometries generation for data augmentation. Second, a neural field-based surrogate model, conditioned on this geometric encoding, is trained to predict ventricular displacement under external loading. The proposed architecture performs positional encoding by using universal ventricular coordinates, which improves generalization across diverse anatomies. Geometric variability is encoded using two alternative strategies, which are systematically compared: a PCA-based approach suitable for working with point cloud representations of geometries, and a DeepSDF-based implicit neural representation learned directly from point clouds. Overall, our results, obtained on idealized and patient-specific datasets, show that the proposed approaches allow for accurate predictions and generalization to unseen geometries, and robustness to noisy or sparsely sampled inputs.
zh_abstract: 心脏力学的高保真计算模型可提供对心脏功能的机制性洞见，但对于常规临床使用而言计算成本过高。代理模型（surrogate models）可以加速仿真，但跨多样解剖结构的泛化具有挑战性，尤其是在数据稀缺的条件下。我们提出一个两步框架，将几何表示与物理响应的学习解耦，以便在数据稀缺条件下实现形状信息驱动的代理建模。首先，形状模型学习左心室几何的紧凑潜表示。学到的潜空间有效编码了解剖结构，并能够生成合成几何用于数据增强。其次，一个基于神经场（neural field）的代理模型以该几何编码为条件，被训练用于预测外部载荷下的心室位移。所提出的架构通过使用通用心室坐标（universal ventricular coordinates）进行位置编码，从而提高了跨多样解剖结构的泛化能力。几何变异性使用两种备选策略进行编码，并对其进行了系统比较：一种适合处理几何点云表示的基于 PCA 的方法，以及一种直接从点云学习的基于 DeepSDF 的隐式神经表示。总体而言，我们在理想化和患者特异性数据集上获得的结果显示，所提出的方法能够实现准确预测和对未见几何的泛化，并且对含噪或稀疏采样的输入具有鲁棒性。

title: Effects of Artificial Intelligence Chatbot Interventions on Women during Pregnancy and Postpartum: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI 聊天机器人干预对孕产期女性的效果：系统综述与 meta 分析
summary: 该系统综述与 meta 分析汇总多项实验研究，评估 AI 聊天机器人对孕期与产后女性干预的效果。
key_points: 检索 PubMed、Cochrane、Embase 等五个数据库
纳入英文或韩文的同行评审实验研究
关注孕期与产后实时交互式支持效果
reason: 系统综述与 meta 分析，但摘要未给出纳入研究数量与结论，未达 7 分档
abstract: [Healthcare informatics research] Artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots are increasingly used in maternal healthcare to provide real-time, interactive, personalized support. This systematic review and meta-analysis examined the effects of AI chatbot interventions on women during pregnancy and postpartum. PubMed, the Cochrane Library, Embase, the Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature, and the Research Information Sharing System were searched from September 11 to 16, 2025, using the search string "(("Artificial Intelligence"[Mesh] OR "AI"[tiab] OR "Machine Learning"[tiab]) AND ("Chatbot"[tiab] OR "Conversational Agent*"[tiab]) AND ("Pregnancy"[Mesh] OR prenatal[tiab] OR antenatal[tiab] OR postnatal[tiab] OR postpartum[tiab])". Eligible studies were peer-reviewed experimental studies published in English or Korean that evaluated chatbot interventions for women during pregnancy or postpartum. Six studies (four randomized controlled trials and two nonrandomized controlled trials) were included. Intervention themes included gestational diabetes, postpartum depression, well-being, maternal-fetal attachment, aneuploidy testing, and breastfeeding. Individual trials reported improvements in knowledge, self-efficacy, and attachment, as well as reductions in symptoms. The meta-analysis showed no significant effect on depression (estimate = 0.037, p = 0.662) or anxiety (estimate = -0.084, p = 0.279); heterogeneity was low (I² = 0%). AI chatbot interventions show promise for improving maternal knowledge, self-efficacy, and attachment. However, the available evidence does not show consistent reductions in depression or anxiety. Large, rigorously designed studies are needed to refine intervention strategies, ensure equity, and establish a robust basis for integrating these interventions into maternal healthcare systems.
zh_abstract: [医疗信息学研究] 人工智能（AI）聊天机器人在孕产妇保健中越来越多地用于提供实时、交互式、个性化支持。本系统综述与荟萃分析考察了AI聊天机器人干预对孕期和产后女性的效果。检索PubMed、Cochrane Library、Embase、Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature和Research Information Sharing System，检索时间为2025年9月11日至16日，检索式为“(("Artificial Intelligence"[Mesh] OR "AI"[tiab] OR "Machine Learning"[tiab]) AND ("Chatbot"[tiab] OR "Conversational Agent*"[tiab]) AND ("Pregnancy"[Mesh] OR prenatal[tiab] OR antenatal[tiab] OR postnatal[tiab] OR postpartum[tiab]))”。纳入研究为以英文或韩文发表的同行评议实验性研究，评估针对孕期或产后女性的聊天机器人干预。共纳入6项研究（4项随机对照试验和2项非随机对照试验）。干预主题包括妊娠期糖尿病、产后抑郁、幸福感、母胎依恋、非整倍体检测和母乳喂养。各单项试验报告了知识、自我效能和依恋的改善以及症状的减轻。荟萃分析显示对抑郁（估计值 = 0.037，p = 0.662）或焦虑（估计值 = -0.084，p = 0.279）无显著效应；异质性低（I² = 0%）。AI聊天机器人干预在改善孕产妇知识、自我效能和依恋方面显示出前景。然而，现有证据并未显示抑郁或焦虑的一致降低。需要大规模、严谨设计的研究来完善干预策略、确保公平性，并为将这些干预整合到孕产妇保健系统建立坚实基础。

title: ClinDataBench: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in Clinical Trial Analysis Dataset Construction
zh_title: ClinDataBench：临床试验分析数据集构建智能体基准
summary: 预印本提出基于CDISC公开试点研究的基准，评测大模型智能体构建临床试验分析数据集的能力。
key_points: 任务为从原始试验数据、SAP与数据集规范生成ADaM分析数据集
现有工作未评测完整、合规且可复现的数据包
标准校验器只查结构，不查数值推导是否正确
reason: 新基准且基于公开数据，但为预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: A new drug reaches patients only after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has reviewed its trial evidence, which every application carries as analysis datasets in the Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Analysis Data Model (ADaM) format that programmers derive by hand from raw trial data, a statistical analysis plan (SAP) and dataset specifications. Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs) could take over this work, and a slow-changing industry will adopt them only with evidence of what they get right and wrong. However, work on large language models (LLMs) for CDISC data stops short of evaluating a complete, conformant and reproducible package, and the standard validator checks structure rather than whether each value is derived correctly. We introduce ClinDataBench, built on the public CDISC pilot study: an agent receives 22 Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) domains, the statistical analysis plan (SAP) and specifications, and must deliver 13 Analysis Data Model (ADaM) datasets, Define-XML metadata and a program that rebuilds them offline. Agents run in containers whose only network route is their model API, restricting online access to published reference outputs during execution. A host-only evaluator scores conformance under the Pinnacle 21 Community (P21) validator, selected derivations, clean reconstruction and effort separately. We compare three settings: Base, which submits the agent's first package; Self-Refine, which revises it without external validation feedback; and CRITIC, which revises it with the agent's own validator report. In an exploratory pilot with six models, the three closed models and DeepSeek delivered all 13 datasets in every setting and eleven of their twelve packages rebuilt semantically, while two other open-weight models delivered no complete package. Validator findings ranged from 15 to 64 dataset-rule pairs. Four of six CRITIC workflows had usable validator comparisons, and each reduced its finding count. None reduced its failed derivation count. The package with the fewest findings carried none of the 234 efficacy summary records in the form the specifications define, showing that lower validator finding counts do not necessarily indicate more correct derivations.
zh_abstract: 一种新药只有在U.S. Food and Drug Administration（FDA）审查其试验证据后才会到达患者手中；每份申请都以分析数据集的形式提交这些证据，这些数据集采用Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium（CDISC）分析数据模型（ADaM）格式，由程序员从原始试验数据手工衍生，并附有统计分析计划（SAP）和数据集规范。基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体可能接管这项工作，而一个变化缓慢的行业只有在有证据表明它们哪些做对、哪些做错时才会采用它们。然而，针对CDISC数据的大语言模型（LLM）工作尚未评估一个完整、符合规范且可复现的包，而标准验证器检查的是结构，而不是每个值是否被正确衍生。我们推出ClinDataBench，它基于公开的CDISC试点研究构建：智能体接收22个研究数据表格模型（SDTM）域、统计分析计划（SAP）和规范，并且必须交付13个分析数据模型（ADaM）数据集、Define-XML元数据以及一个可离线重建它们的程序。智能体在容器中运行，其唯一网络路径是其模型API，从而在执行期间限制对已发表参考输出的在线访问。一个仅主机端运行的评估器分别对Pinnacle 21 Community（P21）验证器下的符合性、选定的衍生、干净重建和工作量进行评分。我们比较三种设置：Base，提交智能体的第一个包；Self-Refine，在没有外部验证反馈的情况下修订它；以及CRITIC，利用智能体自己的验证器报告修订它。在一项包含六个模型的探索性试点中，三个闭源模型和DeepSeek在每种设置下都交付了全部13个数据集，并且它们的12个包中有11个在语义上重建成功，而另外两个开放权重模型未交付任何完整的包。验证器发现项范围为15至64个数据集-规则对。六个CRITIC工作流中有四个具有可用的验证器比较，并且每一个都减少了其发现项数量。没有一个减少了其失败衍生的数量。发现项最少的包未以规范定义的形式包含234条疗效汇总记录中的任何一条，表明较低的验证器发现项数量并不一定意味着更正确的衍生。

title: Simulation and temporal validation of ICU trajectories after stroke: patient condition, transfer readiness and actual ICU exit
zh_title: 卒中后ICU转归的模拟与时序验证
summary: 基于MIMIC IV的6366例卒中ICU住院，构建逐小时模拟器分别刻画病情、转出准备度与ICU转出，并在2017-2019与2020年后队列作时序验证。
key_points: MIMIC IV共6366例卒中ICU住院
在1714例与1521例上做时序验证
主要指标为24小时存活转出Brier分数
与梯度提升直接模型预测精度相当
reason: 有独立时序验证队列，但为回顾性预印本
abstract: Objective: To describe how intensive care unit (ICU) time is composed after stroke, and to test whether simulating patient condition, transfer readiness and ICU exit separately predicts as accurately as direct models. Materials and Methods: In 6,366 ICU stays for stroke in MIMIC IV, hourly readiness criteria divided ICU hours into organ support needs, stroke specific needs, and time not explained by these needs. An hourly simulator was built on stays up to 2016, frozen, and validated on 2017 to 2019 (n=1,714) and 2020 onwards (n=1,521). The primary measure was the 24 hour alive exit Brier score versus the strongest direct model (gradient boosting). Results: Unexplained time was 34.1% of hours in standard ICUs and 87.6% in neuro intermediate units. 37.8% of stays lost readiness for [≥]6 consecutive hours after first confirmation. The simulator and gradient boosting were indistinguishable (Brier 0.1238 vs 0.1245; difference -0.0007, 95% CI -0.0030 to 0.0016). The simulator was better calibrated at 48 and 72 hours but discriminated less well (C statistic 0.71 vs 0.74 to 0.75). All models overpredicted exit after 2016; the error lay mainly after readiness (median 40 hours simulated vs 68 observed). Discussion: Readiness was not a single event: patients often lost and regained it, and many stayed long after meeting it, especially in neuro intermediate units, which exist for monitoring. Separate modelling did not improve accuracy but placed the post 2016 error after readiness, as the unit mix changed. Conclusion: The simulator matched the strongest direct model while also generating complete trajectories. It needs external validation before any clinical use.
zh_abstract: 【目的】描述卒中后重症监护病房（ICU）时间如何构成，并检验分别模拟患者状况、转出准备度和ICU转出是否与直接模型预测同样准确。【材料与方法】在MIMIC IV的6,366次卒中ICU住院中，逐小时准备度标准将ICU小时划分为器官支持需求、卒中特异性需求以及无法由这些需求解释的时间。基于截至2016年的住院数据构建逐小时模拟器，将其冻结，并在2017年至2019年（n=1,714）和2020年及以后（n=1,521）进行验证。主要指标是与最强直接模型（梯度提升）比较的24小时存活转出Brier评分。【结果】无法解释的时间在标准ICU中占34.1%的小时数，在神经中间病房（neuro intermediate units）中占87.6%。37.8%的住院在首次确认准备就绪后连续≥6小时失去准备度。模拟器与梯度提升无法区分（Brier 0.1238 vs 0.1245；差值-0.0007，95% CI -0.0030至0.0016）。模拟器在48和72小时校准更好，但区分度较差（C统计量0.71 vs 0.74至0.75）。所有模型均高估了2016年之后的转出；误差主要位于达到准备度之后（模拟中位40小时 vs 观察68小时）。【讨论】准备度并非单一事件：患者常失去并重新获得准备度，许多患者在达到准备度后仍停留很久，尤其是在以监测为目的的神经中间病房。分开建模未提高准确性，但将2016年后的误差置于准备度之后，因为病房构成发生了变化。【结论】该模拟器与最强直接模型相匹配，同时还能生成完整轨迹。在任何临床使用前需要外部验证。

title: Expert-level localization of fine-grained cardiac structures across the transthoracic echocardiogram.
source: PubMed · medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
zh_title: 经胸超声心动图细微心脏结构的专家级定位
summary: 预印本：EchoLens基于5912个专家标注结构训练，在外部数据中定位21种心脏结构，两名医师判定81–92%检测正确。
key_points: 通用与医学视觉语言模型召回率仅3%或更低
EchoLens召回87%，定位可靠性与盲法专家读者相当
覆盖11个经胸视图的21种结构与11类多普勒信号
reason: 含外部数据与医师评估、与视觉语言模型对照，但样本136例且为预印本
abstract: [medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences] 1.Artificial intelligence models for echocardiography interpret studies without identifying the structures that support their outputs. We show that this spatial grounding does not emerge from the pretraining of current vision-language models. General-purpose and medical vision-language models and an open-vocabulary detector recalled 3% or fewer of cardiac structures and scored below a box that never sees the image. EchoLens, a detector trained on 5,912 expert-annotated structures and 4,219 Doppler signals from 136 patients, recalled 87% and localized structures as reliably as a blinded expert reader (box centre within the reference in 95.7% and 95.3% of cases). It covers 21 structures across 11 transthoracic views and 11 spectral Doppler signal types. In external data, two physicians judged 81- 92% of its detections correct across all 11 views, and it identified the Doppler signal type in 83% of frames. EchoLens provides the spatial layer that grounded echocardiographic interpretation requires.
zh_abstract: [medRxiv：健康科学预印本服务器] 用于超声心动图的人工智能模型可解读检查，但不识别支撑其输出的结构。我们表明，这种空间定位（spatial grounding）并不会从当前视觉-语言模型的预训练中涌现。通用和医学视觉-语言模型以及一个开放词汇检测器召回了 3% 或更少的心脏结构，并且得分低于一个从未看到图像的框（box）。EchoLens 是一个在来自 136 名患者的 5,912 个专家标注结构和 4,219 个多普勒信号上训练的检测器，其召回率为 87%，并且定位结构的可靠性与盲法专家读者相当（在 95.7% 和 95.3% 的病例中，框中心位于参考范围内）。它覆盖 11 个经胸切面中的 21 个结构和 11 种频谱多普勒信号类型。在外部数据中，两名医生判断其在所有 11 个切面上的检测中 81-92% 为正确，并且它在 83% 的帧中识别出多普勒信号类型。EchoLens 提供了有依据的超声心动图解读所需的空间层。

title: AI Treatment Recommendations With Predicted Consequences for Sepsis Fluid and Vasopressor Decisions
zh_title: 脓毒症液体与升压药决策：AI 建议附预测后果的干预试验
summary: 南京大学注册的干预性试验，检验在 AI 治疗建议之外展示预测后果能否帮助临床医生采纳恰当建议。
key_points: 注册干预试验，计划入组 72 例，正在招募
构建以值班医生方案为锚的反事实模型
仅在预测获益跨多种假设稳健时才建议改变
reason: 前瞻性干预设计有新意，但样本小且尚无结果，属值得一看档
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Nanjing University; conditions: Sepsis, Septic Shock; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 72; status: RECRUITING] When artificial intelligence (AI) recommends a treatment, clinicians must decide whether to follow it. This study tests whether showing the predicted consequences of a recommendation, in addition to the recommendation itself, helps clinicians accept appropriate advice and reject inappropriate advice. We developed a clinician-anchored counterfactual model that compares the on-duty clinician's intravenous fluid and vasopressor plan with alternative plans for patients with sepsis. It predicts the patient's course under each plan and recommends a change only when the predicted benefit holds across several plausible assumptions about unrecorded factors; otherwise it states that the evidence is insufficient to recommend a change. About 72 physicians from two hospitals, stratified by seniority, will review 30 retrospective, de-identified ICU decision points from patients with sepsis. In stage 1, each physician independently specifies fluid and vasopressor doses without any AI information. In stage 2, the same cases are reviewed under three conditions assigned by counterbalanced sequences: the case with the on-duty clinician's plan and no AI (B0); B0 plus the AI recommendation (B1); and B1 plus the predicted consequences of the on-duty and recommended plans (B2). The AI recommendation is identical in B1 and B2. Decision quality is assessed against plans made independently by expert intensivists. No patients are enrolled, and participants' decisions do not affect patient care.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：南京大学；疾病：脓毒症、脓毒性休克；类型：干预性；阶段：NA；入组人数：72；状态：招募中] 当人工智能（AI）推荐一种治疗时，临床医生必须决定是否遵循。本研究检验：在推荐本身之外同时展示该推荐的预测后果，是否有助于临床医生接受适当建议并拒绝不适当建议。我们开发了一种以临床医生为锚点的反事实模型，将值班临床医生对脓毒症患者的静脉液体和血管升压药方案与替代方案进行比较。它预测每种方案下患者的病程，并且仅当预测获益在关于未记录因素的若干合理假设下均成立时，才建议改变；否则说明证据不足以建议改变。来自两家医院约72名医生将按资历分层，审阅30个来自脓毒症患者的回顾性、去标识化ICU决策点。第1阶段，每名医生在没有任何AI信息的情况下独立指定液体和血管升压药剂量。第2阶段，相同病例在由平衡序列分配的三种条件下审阅：病例加值班临床医生方案且无AI（B0）；B0加AI推荐（B1）；以及B1加值班方案和推荐方案的预测后果（B2）。AI推荐在B1和B2中完全相同。决策质量依据由专家重症监护医师独立制定的方案评估。不纳入任何患者，参与者的决策不影响患者照护。

title: AI-driven reconstruction of maxillary complete denture bases: a clinical feasibility study.
zh_title: AI重建上颌全口义齿基托的临床可行性研究
summary: 基于79例口扫数据训练AI模型重建上颌全口义齿基托全表面几何形态。
key_points: 79例无牙上颌口扫与临床可接受义齿数据
57例训练、7例验证、15例测试
采用强调边缘特征的PointNet++与边缘注意力机制
reason: 单中心小样本可行性研究，仅内部测试集
abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] Digital denture workflows remain limited by the inability of intraoral scanners (IOS) to capture functional soft-tissue dynamics and peripheral border molding. This clinical feasibility study evaluated whole-surface geometric reconstruction of maxillary complete denture bases from IOS data using a novel artificial intelligence (AI) model in which peripheral border features were emphasized during training. IOS datasets of the edentulous maxilla and corresponding clinically acceptable dentures from 79 patients were used to train an enhanced PointNet + + model incorporating a border-attention mechanism. The dataset was divided into 57 training, 7 validation, and 15 test cases. Whole-surface point-cloud performance was evaluated in the held-out test set using Density-Aware Chamfer Distance, maximum Hausdorff distance, and multi-threshold precision, recall, and F-scores. Whole-surface registration RMSE was additionally calculated for three randomly selected test-set cases that underwent additive manufacturing and an exploratory clinical try-in. On an independent test set, the mean Chamfer Distance was 2.6 ± 0.1 mm and the maximum Hausdorff distance was 2.4 mm. F-scores increased from 0.8 at a 0.5-mm tolerance to 1.0 at a 2.0-mm tolerance. Whole-surface RMSE values for the three pilot cases ranged from 0.4 to 0.6 mm. The additively manufactured AI denture bases showed promising adaptation and positional stability in this pilot evaluation; however, conventionally fabricated dentures provided superior retention. Within the study's limitations, the AI model showed potential for whole-surface reconstruction of maxillary denture bases from IOS data. However, in the descriptive try-in of three cases, the patients' existing conventional dentures were subjectively more retentive than the additively manufactured AI-generated bases. AI-based denture-base reconstruction from IOS data may contribute to future fully digital workflows. Before clinical implementation, border-specific geometric validation, larger external datasets, and objective measurements of retention, adaptation, and positional stability are required.
zh_abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] 数字义齿工作流程仍受限于口内扫描仪（IOS）无法捕捉功能性软组织动态和外围边缘整塑。这项临床可行性研究评估了利用一种新型人工智能（AI）模型从 IOS 数据对上颌全口义齿基托进行全表面几何重建，该模型在训练中强调了外围边缘特征。使用来自 79 名患者的无牙上颌及相应临床可接受义齿的 IOS 数据集，训练了一个纳入边界注意力机制的增强 PointNet + + 模型。数据集被分为 57 个训练、7 个验证和 15 个测试病例。在留出测试集中，使用 Density-Aware Chamfer Distance、最大 Hausdorff 距离以及多阈值精确率、召回率和 F 分数评估全表面点云性能。此外，对三个随机选出的测试集病例计算了全表面配准 RMSE，这些病例接受了增材制造和探索性临床试戴。在独立测试集上，平均 Chamfer Distance 为 2.6 ± 0.1 mm，最大 Hausdorff 距离为 2.4 mm。F 分数从 0.5-mm 容差下的 0.8 增至 2.0-mm 容差下的 1.0。三个试点病例的全表面 RMSE 值为 0.4 至 0.6 mm。在此试点评估中，增材制造的 AI 义齿基托显示出有希望的适配性和位置稳定性；然而，传统制造的义齿提供了更优的固位力。在研究局限范围内，该 AI 模型显示出从 IOS 数据全表面重建上颌义齿基托的潜力。然而，在对三例的描述性试戴中，患者现有传统义齿在主观上比增材制造的 AI 生成基托更具固位力。基于 AI 从 IOS 数据进行义齿基托重建可能有助于未来全数字化工作流程。在临床实施之前，需要进行边缘特异性几何验证、更大的外部数据集，以及固位力、适配性和位置稳定性的客观测量。

title: Effects of AI-Assisted Clinical Recommendations on Dental Students' Endodontic Antibiotic Prescribing Decisions

summary: 三臂随机在线试验，328名牙科学生面对10个牙髓病例，比较无AI建议、指南一致建议与混合准确度建议对处方决策的影响，已完成但无结果。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Tolga Mavigöz; conditions: Antibiotic Prescribing Decision-Making; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 328; status: COMPLETED] This study evaluated how artificial intelligence (AI)-formatted clinical recommendations influence dental students' decisions about prescribing systemic antibiotics in endodontic cases. In this randomized, three-arm, parallel-group, online experimental study, third-, fourth-, and fifth-year dental students in Türkiye were assigned to one of three conditions: a Control group receiving no AI recommendations, a Guideline-concordant AI group receiving recommendations consistent with established clinical guidance, or a Mixed-accuracy AI group receiving recommendations with varying levels of accuracy. Participants evaluated ten hypothetical endodontic clinical scenarios and decided whether systemic antibiotic treatment was indicated. The primary outcome was the accuracy of antibiotic prescribing decisions compared with predefined reference decisions. Secondary outcomes included confidence in clinical decisions, trust in AI recommendations, agreement with recommendations, identification of potentially incorrect information, and inappropriate antibiotic prescribing patterns. Data were collected between July 1 and July 6, 2026. A total of 328 participants were randomized, 318 met the eligibility criteria, and 271 completed all ten primary decision questions.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：Tolga Mavigöz；状况：抗生素处方决策；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组：328；状态：已完成（COMPLETED）] 本研究评估了由人工智能（AI）格式化的临床建议如何影响牙科学生对牙髓病例中全身抗生素处方的决策。在这项随机、三臂、平行组、在线实验研究中，土耳其的三年级、四年级和五年级牙科学生被分配到三种条件之一：不接受AI建议的对照组、接受与既定临床指南一致的AI建议的指南一致AI组，或接受准确性水平不同的AI建议的混合准确性AI组。参与者评估了十个假设的牙髓临床情景，并决定是否具有全身抗生素治疗指征。主要结局是与预设参考决策相比的抗生素处方决策准确性。次要结局包括临床决策信心、对AI建议的信任、对建议的认同、识别可能错误的信息以及不适当抗生素处方模式。数据收集于2026年7月1日至7月6日。共有328名参与者被随机分组，318名符合纳入标准，271名完成了全部十个主要决策问题。

title: The ITE-Transformer: A pre-trained foundation model for predicting individualized treatment effects from electronic health records
zh_title: ITE-Transformer：从电子病历预测个体化治疗效应的基础模型
summary: 预印本提出基于Transformer的框架，结合自监督表征学习与双重稳健因果学习，从纵向电子病历预测个体化治疗效应。
key_points: 从诊断与用药史学习时间上下文表征
结合双重稳健因果方法估计治疗效应
可回答反事实假设下的治疗策略比较
现有EHR基础模型多聚焦风险预测而非疗效
reason: 有新方法的预印本，摘要未见外部验证或临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Transformer-based foundation models have shown strong potential for modeling longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs), yet existing models focus primarily on risk prediction rather than treatment effect estimation, which limits evidence generation. Here, we introduce the ITE-Transformer, a transformer-based framework that combines self-supervised representation learning from longitudinal patient trajectories with doubly robust causal machine learning for predicting individualized treatment effects (ITEs). As a result, our ITE-Transformer allows to study counterfactual questions of how an individual patient's outcome may differ under alternative treatment strategies. The ITE-Transformer learns temporally contextualized representations of patients' diagnosis and medication histories and subsequently uses these representations to predict treatment assignment, treatment-specific outcome risks, and patient-specific ITEs. The ITE-Transformer is trained using structured EHR data from ~350,000 participants in the All of Us Research Program and evaluated in two clinically different comparative-effectiveness tasks: (i) GLP-1 receptor agonists versus DPP-4 inhibitors among patients with type 2 diabetes, with major adverse cardiovascular events as the outcome, and (ii) immunotherapy versus chemotherapy in a pan-cancer cohort, with all-cause mortality as the outcome. Across both applications, the ITE-Transformer improves the discrimination and calibration of treatment assignment and outcome models compared with existing tabular machine learning approaches and an otherwise identical transformer trained without self-supervised pre-training. The ITE-Transformer further identifies substantial heterogeneity in predicted ITEs and yields interpretable patterns of treatment response associated with patients' diagnoses, medication histories, and comorbidities. Together, our work demonstrates how clinical foundation models can be developed for analyzing heterogeneity in treatment effects and thus support real-world evidence generation.
zh_abstract: 基于Transformer的基础模型在纵向电子健康记录（EHR）建模中显示出强大潜力，但现有模型主要关注风险预测而非治疗效应估计，这限制了证据生成。在此，我们介绍ITE-Transformer，一个基于Transformer的框架，它将对纵向患者轨迹的自监督表征学习与用于预测个体化治疗效应（ITE）的双重稳健因果机器学习相结合。因此，我们的ITE-Transformer能够研究反事实问题：在替代治疗策略下，个体患者的结局可能如何不同。ITE-Transformer学习患者诊断和用药史的时间情境化表征，随后使用这些表征预测治疗分配、治疗特异性结局风险以及患者特异性ITE。ITE-Transformer使用来自All of Us Research Program约350,000名参与者的结构化EHR数据进行训练，并在两个临床不同的比较有效性任务中评估：（i）2型糖尿病患者中GLP-1受体激动剂与DPP-4抑制剂的比较，结局为主要不良心血管事件；（ii）泛癌队列中免疫治疗与化疗的比较，结局为全因死亡率。在两个应用中，与现有表格机器学习方法以及一个在其他方面相同但未进行自监督预训练的transformer相比，ITE-Transformer改善了治疗分配模型和结局模型的区分度和校准度。ITE-Transformer进一步识别出预测ITE中的显著异质性，并产生与患者诊断、用药史和合并症相关的可解释治疗反应模式。总之，我们的工作展示了如何开发临床基础模型来分析治疗效应异质性，从而支持真实世界证据生成。

title: Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
zh_title: 专家漂移下的学习延迟决策框架
summary: 预印本提出EDA-L2D框架，用序列模型建模专家可靠性随时间波动，使延迟决策策略自适应调整。
key_points: 现有延迟决策研究多假设专家可靠性固定
以专家历史结果序列条件化延迟决策头
提及放射、航空等高风险场景的人机分工
reason: 有清晰新问题设定的预印本方法研究，摘要未报告医学场景实证或外部验证
abstract: The learning to defer (L2D) framework enables safety in machine learning and AI systems by allocating difficult or critical decisions to a human expert. However, most prior work on L2D assumes fixed expert reliability, overlooking temporal fluctuations in human performance due to factors such as fatigue and cognitive biases. Humans commonly exhibit such substantial, systematic performance shifts across a wide range of domains, from high-stakes settings such as radiology, aviation, and judicial decision-making, to everyday tasks such as crowdsourced image annotation. We propose Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer (EDA-L2D), a novel expert-aware L2D framework that explicitly models these temporal shifts by conditioning the deferral head on recent histories of expert outcomes via a sequence model. This history-aware approach enables adaptive deferral policies that anticipate reliability fluctuations and better allocate decisions between human and machine over time. We provide comprehensive experiments across three diverse tasks -- image classification, medical diagnosis, and hate speech detection -- including generalization analyses under realistic deferral conditions and irregular shifts in expert reliability. Our results show that EDA-L2D adapts more effectively than prior L2D methods to diverse temporal patterns of expert reliability, resulting in improved system performance and more effective deferral decisions. Code is available at https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift.
zh_abstract: 学习推迟决策（learning to defer, L2D）框架通过将困难或关键决策分配给人类专家，使机器学习和人工智能系统具备安全性。然而，先前关于L2D的大多数工作假设专家可靠性固定，忽视了由于疲劳和认知偏差等因素导致的人类表现随时间波动。人类在广泛领域中通常表现出这种显著、系统性的性能变化，从放射学、航空和司法决策等高风险场景，到众包图像标注等日常任务。我们提出专家漂移自适应学习推迟决策（Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer, EDA-L2D），这是一种新颖的专家感知L2D框架，通过序列模型使推迟决策头以专家近期结果历史为条件，从而显式建模这些时间变化。这种历史感知方法能够实现自适应推迟策略，以预判可靠性波动，并随时间更好地在人与机器之间分配决策。我们在三项不同任务——图像分类、医学诊断和仇恨言论检测——中进行了全面实验，包括在现实推迟条件下及专家可靠性不规则变化下的泛化分析。我们的结果表明，EDA-L2D比先前的L2D方法更有效地适应专家可靠性的多种时间模式，从而改善系统性能并做出更有效的推迟决策。代码见 https://github.com/ZiyaoMou/L2D-Expert-Drift。

title: NeuroSim: a clinically informed multi-disorder EEG simulator with personalized pattern injection and AI-driven neurological modeling
zh_title: NeuroSim：可注入个体化病理模式的多疾病EEG模拟器
summary: 提出可生成五种神经疾病、多严重程度合成多通道EEG的仿真框架，用于缓解标注数据稀缺与隐私限制。
key_points: 覆盖阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、精神分裂症、癫痫、额颞叶痴呆
用户可控地注入疾病特异性模式与严重程度
基线生成器模拟节律、事件相关电位与伪迹
reason: 预印本新方法，针对真实数据稀缺问题，但条目未给出外部验证结果
abstract: Deep learning for electroencephalography (EEG) based neurodiagnostics is constrained by the limited availability of labeled clinical recordings. Datasets covering Alzheimers disease (AD), Parkinsons disease (PD), schizophrenia (SCZ), epilepsy (EPI), and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) are scarce, demographically narrow, and heterogeneous across acquisition sites, while privacy requirements restrict data sharing. Existing EEG simulators typically address a single disorder or trade biological interpretability for statistical fidelity. This study presents NeuroSim, a simulation framework that generates synthetic multichannel EEG with user-controlled injection of disease-specific patterns across five disorders and multiple severity levels. A physiologically motivated baseline generator produces band-limited rhythms, event-related potentials, artifacts, and hierarchical subject-level and trial-level variability. Disease patterns are introduced through region-specific and severity-specific spectral modulation that encodes established biomarkers, including posterior alpha suppression in AD, motor beta enhancement in PD, and spike-wave discharges in EPI. An interactive interface exposes montage, sampling rate, duration, artifacts, stimuli, affected regions, and severity, and exports signals with reproducible metadata. The simulated signals reproduced the expected biomarker directionality under spectral, topographic, and multivariate statistical analysis. A convolutional-attention classifier trained on simulated data reached 95.3 to 96.8 percent hold-out accuracy, and post hoc explainability analyses produced class-separable embeddings with attributions concentrated on pathophysiologically expected electrodes. Application of the analysis pipeline to recordings from the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus confirmed compatibility with heterogeneous clinical data. In subject-level augmentation experiments on real clinical EEG, supplementing real training data with NeuroSim samples increased classification accuracy from 91.6 to 94.5 percent for AD versus healthy controls and from 90.9 to 94.0 percent for PD versus healthy controls, exceeding the improvement obtained with conventional signal-level augmentation. NeuroSim is released as open-source software to support augmentation, benchmarking, and explainable artificial intelligence in neurological diagnostics.
zh_abstract: 基于脑电图（EEG）的神经诊断深度学习受限于标注临床记录的可获得性有限。涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、精神分裂症（SCZ）、癫痫（EPI）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的数据集稀缺、人口学范围狭窄，且在不同采集站点间存在异质性，同时隐私要求限制了数据共享。现有EEG模拟器通常只针对单一疾病，或以生物学可解释性换取统计保真度。本研究提出NeuroSim，一种模拟框架，可生成合成多通道EEG，并允许用户在五种疾病和多个严重程度水平上受控注入疾病特异性模式。一个生理学驱动的基线生成器产生带限节律、事件相关电位、伪迹以及分层的受试者水平和试次水平变异性。疾病模式通过区域特异性和严重程度特异性的频谱调制引入，这些调制编码了已确立的生物标志物，包括AD中的后部α抑制、PD中的运动β增强和EPI中的棘慢波放电。交互式界面可设置导联组合、采样率、时长、伪迹、刺激、受影响区域和严重程度，并导出具有可复现元数据的信号。模拟信号在频谱、地形和多变量统计分析下重现了预期的生物标志物方向性。在模拟数据上训练的卷积-注意力分类器达到95.3%至96.8%的留出集准确率，事后可解释性分析产生了类别可分离的嵌入，其归因集中在病理生理学上预期的电极。将分析流程应用于Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus的记录，证实了与异质性临床数据的兼容性。在真实临床EEG的受试者水平增强实验中，用NeuroSim样本补充真实训练数据使AD与健康对照的分类准确率从91.6%提高到94.5%，使PD与健康对照的分类准确率从90.9%提高到94.0%，超过使用传统信号水平增强所获得的改善。NeuroSim作为开源软件发布，以支持神经诊断中的增强、基准测试和可解释人工智能。

title: Learning RNA secondary structure from chemical probing with MXfold2
zh_title: MXfold2利用化学探测数据学习RNA二级结构
summary: 预印本：扩展MXfold2，用化学探测图谱监督训练，仅凭序列预测RNA二级结构，并提出三种训练目标。
key_points: 化学探测提供核苷酸水平配对信息但不含配对对象
提出三种训练目标，含隐式最大似然代理梯度
模拟与RNAgym测试显示化学一致性及精确配对预测提升
reason: 有新方法且含模拟与外部结构测试，但为预印本、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Training RNA secondary structure predictors is limited by scarce reference annotations, even as chemical probing produces abundant nucleotide-level measurements. These measurements inform pairing states without identifying base-pairing partners. Here we extend MXfold2, which combines neural and thermodynamic folding scores, to learn from probing profiles and predict RNA secondary structures from sequence alone. We introduce three training objectives. One learns from probing-assisted target structures. The other two use implicit maximum-likelihood estimation to pass surrogate gradients from reactivity-ranking and likelihood losses through discrete folding. Simulations, RNAgym measurements and external structural tests show improved chemical agreement and gains in exact base-pair prediction when chemical supervision is combined with structural pretraining and replay. Probing profiles can thus broaden the range of RNAs that inform sequence-only structure prediction, including RNA populations with few complete structure annotations.
zh_abstract: 训练RNA二级结构预测器受到参考注释稀缺的限制，即便化学探测可产生丰富的核苷酸水平测量。这些测量为配对状态提供信息，但不识别碱基配对伴侣。在这里，我们扩展MXfold2——它结合了神经和热力学折叠评分——以从探测图谱中学习，并仅根据序列预测RNA二级结构。我们引入三个训练目标。其中一个从探测辅助的目标结构学习。另外两个使用隐式最大似然估计，将来自反应性排序损失和似然损失的代理梯度通过离散折叠传递。模拟、RNAgym测量和外部结构测试显示，当化学监督与结构预训练和重放相结合时，化学一致性得到改善，精确碱基对预测获得增益。因此，探测图谱可以拓宽为仅序列结构预测提供信息的RNA范围，包括完整结构注释很少的RNA群体。

title: Building an Auditable Reference Standard for Clinical Information Extraction from Transesophageal Echocardiography Reports
zh_title: 经食管超声报告信息抽取的可审计参考标准
summary: 两家机构抽取300份术中经食管超声报告，构建39变量参考标准并分析标注者分歧。
key_points: 两机构随机抽样并富集疑难记录
四名标注者，297份配对比较
分歧经专家裁决并归类原因
reason: 双机构标注资源与一致性分析，属数据/基准类预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Objectives To develop an auditable, two-institution reference standard for intraoperative transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) reports and evaluate whether reviewer disagreement identifies limitations in the underlying clinical information model. Materials and Methods We selected 300 reports (150 per institution) from 925 at the University of Pennsylvania and University of Washington using random sampling and enrichment for challenging documentation. Four trained abstractors applied a shared 39-variable V1 codebook. Independent paired comparisons included 297 reports; three historical reports contributed only to the final reference standard. Categorical agreement used exact agreement and unweighted Cohen's {kappa}; numeric left-ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) used exact agreement and mean absolute differences. Disagreements underwent structured expert adjudication and reason classification. Additional analyses assessed reviewer-pair, sampling-stratified, and population-weighted agreement. Results Among 11,583 formal reviewer-comparison cells, 10,293 (88.9%) were resolved by reviewer agreement and 1,290 (11.1%) required targeted expert adjudication (1,289 tasks). Codebook/schema ambiguity (40.8%) and interpretation/classification differences (25.2%) together accounted for 66.0% of targeted tasks. Adjudication was concentrated in aortic dissection, valve type, and post-intervention findings. Categorical {kappa} ranged from 0.364 to 0.960 and was inversely correlated with targeted-adjudication burden (Spearman {rho}=-0.884; 95% CI, -0.955 to -0.734). Sampling-weighted {kappa} changed by no more than 0.05 for 32 of 35 categorical variables. Discussion Structured adjudication identified recurring schema and interpretation challenges beyond individual abstraction errors, providing specific targets for information-model refinement. Conclusion As NLP and LLM-based abstraction tools move toward clinical use, the reference standards used to evaluate them require comparably rigorous development, adjudication, and independent validation.
zh_abstract: 【目的】制定一套可审计、基于两家机构的术中经食管超声心动图（TEE）报告参考标准，并评估评审者分歧是否能够识别底层临床信息模型的局限。【材料与方法】我们从宾夕法尼亚大学和华盛顿大学的925份报告中，通过随机抽样并针对具有挑战性的记录进行富集，选取了300份报告（每家机构150份）。四名经过培训的提取员应用共享的39变量V1编码本。独立配对比较纳入297份报告；三份历史报告仅用于最终参考标准。分类变量一致性采用完全一致率和未加权Cohen's κ；数值左心室射血分数（LVEF）采用完全一致率和平均绝对差。分歧接受结构化专家裁定和原因分类。附加分析评估评审者对、按抽样分层和按人群加权的一致性。【结果】在11,583个正式评审者比较单元中，10,293个（88.9%）通过评审者一致解决，1,290个（11.1%）需要定向专家裁定（1,289项任务）。编码本/模式歧义（40.8%）和解释/分类差异（25.2%）合计占定向任务的66.0%。裁定集中在主动脉夹层、瓣膜类型和干预后表现。分类κ范围为0.364至0.960，并与定向裁定负担呈负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.884；95% CI，-0.955至-0.734）。对于35个分类变量中的32个，抽样加权κ的变化不超过0.05。【讨论】结构化裁定识别出超越个体提取错误的反复出现的模式和解释挑战，为信息模型改进提供了具体目标。【结论】随着自然语言处理（NLP）和基于大语言模型（LLM）的提取工具迈向临床使用，用于评估它们的参考标准需要同等严格的开发、裁定和独立验证。

title: Automated Screening for Generalized Anxiety Disorder Using Voice Analysis and Machine Learning

abstract: This study evaluated machine learning models for screening elevated generalized anxiety symptoms from remotely collected neutral read speech in 1,788 adults from Botswana, Ghana, Nigeria, and Tanzania. Elevated symptoms were defined by Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7-item (GAD-7) questionnaire scores [≥] 5. Nine classifiers were assessed across nine scenarios defined by speech-task configuration (short sentence, long passage, or both tasks) and sex stratification under participant-separated, repeated nested cross-validation (CV). Acoustic-only models used the extended Geneva Minimalistic Acoustic Parameter Set, and context-augmented models added age, self-reported health, and sex where applicable. With feature selection, the highest mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCROC) was 0.594 for acoustic-only models and 0.699 for context-augmented models, the latter in the female-only combined-task scenario. Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) identified fundamental frequency descriptors as prominent acoustic predictors, while health status and age were the leading predictors in context-augmented models. Performance varied across scenarios, and feature selection provided no consistent benefit. Secondary regression poorly estimated continuous symptom severity. These findings indicate limited discrimination from neutral speech acoustics alone and improved performance with participant context, warranting external validation.
zh_abstract: 本研究评估了机器学习模型，用于从博茨瓦纳、加纳、尼日利亚和坦桑尼亚1,788名成年人远程采集的中性朗读语音中筛查广泛性焦虑症状升高。症状升高定义为广泛性焦虑障碍7项（GAD-7）问卷评分≥5。在参与者分离的重复嵌套交叉验证（CV）下，按语音任务配置（短句、长段落或两项任务）和性别分层定义的九种场景中评估了九种分类器。仅声学模型使用扩展日内瓦最小声学参数集（eGeMAPS），上下文增强模型在适用时加入年龄、自报健康状况和性别。在特征选择下，仅声学模型的最高平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUCROC）为0.594，上下文增强模型为0.699，后者出现在仅女性合并任务场景。Shapley加性解释（SHAP）识别出基频描述符为突出的声学预测因子，而健康状况和年龄是上下文增强模型中的主要预测因子。性能因场景而异，特征选择未提供一致获益。次要回归对连续症状严重程度的估计较差。这些发现表明，仅凭中性语音声学区分能力有限，加入参与者上下文后性能改善，值得进行外部验证。

zh_abstract: 【背景】患者在疾病和照护方面的困难（不理解某项结果、痛苦、日常限制、不知道去哪里、家庭压力）可能不会在临床就诊或记录中显现。关于以患者为中心的药物开发的监管指南将社交媒体倾听认定为患者体验数据的来源，但在台湾的繁体中文讨论中尚无系统框架，且关键词流程对此类内容的测量效果很差。【目的】使用一个八领域、结合台湾情境的框架，描述台湾在线健康讨论中患者表达的需求、负担和障碍（“摩擦”），识别这些摩擦属于谁，并评估每一项被测量的可靠程度。【方法】从PTT论坛和三项问医生服务的1360万单元档案中，由大语言模型根据相关性、作者（患者或家庭成员）和八个领域的评分细则，全文阅读9,131个流程标记单元和1,000篇未标记论坛文章的种子样本（10,130个不同单元）；八个领域为：信息缺口、情感负担、生活方式负担、用药体验、系统导航、获取障碍、照护者负担和费用负担。分别报告论坛文章和医生提交内容的画像，并与第二家供应商、两名医生对160个接受和拒绝单元的独立标注以及该档案的关键词流程进行核对。【结果】在2,395篇模型确认的论坛文章中，83.1%表达了至少一种摩擦：信息缺口59.5%（医生为86%-93%）、情感负担39.0%、用药体验24.1%、生活方式负担22.2%和系统导航16.3%；获取障碍、照护者负担和费用负担均低于7%。在3,105份提交中，几乎所有都是问题，且53.8%也带有负担。导航很少涉及保险（9.1%）。家庭成员撰写的论坛文章（14.5%）更常表达情感负担（54.9% vs 36.3%）、导航（34.8% vs 13.2%；依赖测量工具）和获取障碍（16.4% vs 4.7%），而患者撰写的文章更常表达生活方式负担（24.8% vs 6.9%）；在表达照护者负担的文章中，86.0%同时伴有情感负担。在模型、第二家供应商和两名医生下，情感负担和生活方式负担在论坛文章中比提交中更常见；用药体验和导航依赖测量工具，医生在费用上存在分歧（32% vs 4%）。关键词流程已为29.9%的模型确...存储了其信息缺口输出

title: Patient- and Family-Expressed Needs and Burdens in Kidney-Related Online Discussions in Taiwan: Large Language Model-Based Analysis Across Clinical Contexts

summary: 用大语言模型分析台湾论坛与问诊服务共22170条帖子，按临床情境和作者身份梳理肾脏病患者的未满足需求与负担。

abstract: Introduction: What people with kidney concerns or disease and their families struggle with between visits may not surface in clinic. We mapped the needs and burdens they express online by clinical context and author. Methods: A large language model read all 22,170 posts reached by a chronic kidney disease tag or kidney lexicon on a Taiwanese forum and 3 ask-a-physician services (1995-2026), applying a companion friction framework with kidney-specific fields, author (patient or family) and clinical context. A second vendor re-read 11,010 posts; 2 physicians labelled relevance, author and context in 200. Results: Among 6,023 kidney-related posts, the reproducibly measured fields most often voiced on the forum were information needs (79%), emotional burden (48%), system navigation (34%) and worry about progression (24%). After abnormal tests, 54%-56% of posts quoted a laboratory value, nearly always with a question or stated uncertainty; renal-diet burden peaked with diagnosed disease; caregiver burden rose to 29% of dialysis-or-transplantation forum posts. Family-written posts more often voiced navigation difficulty and caregiver burden. Most fields agreed with the second vendor (kappa 0.65-0.98). On the model's labels, family members wrote 25% of forum posts about kidney concerns and 74% about dialysis or transplantation; on a 139-post sample, physicians' labels gave 47%-48% for dialysis or transplantation (model 71%). Conclusion: Kidney-related posts carry context-specific information needs and emotional and practical burdens, many voiced by relatives. They suggest candidate responses (test-result explanation, diet support, family-directed information and support) that need evaluation. Keywords: chronic kidney disease; dialysis; patient experience; caregivers; social media; large language models
zh_abstract: 【引言】有肾脏担忧或疾病的人及其家属在就诊间隔期所挣扎的问题可能不会在门诊中显现。我们按临床情境和作者，对他们在线表达的需求和负担进行了映射。【方法】一个大语言模型阅读了台湾一个论坛和 3 个问医生服务（1995-2026）中由慢性肾脏病标签或肾脏词典触达的全部 22,170 篇帖子，应用一个伴随摩擦框架（companion friction framework），包含肾脏特异性字段、作者（患者或家属）和临床情境。第二家供应商重新阅读了 11,010 篇帖子；2 名医生在 200 篇中标注了相关性、作者和情境。【结果】在 6,023 篇肾脏相关帖子中，论坛上最常被表达的可重复测量字段是信息需求（79%）、情绪负担（48%）、系统导航（34%）和对疾病进展的担忧（24%）。在异常检查后，54%-56% 的帖子引用了实验室数值，几乎总是伴随一个问题或明确的不确定性；肾脏饮食负担在已确诊疾病时达到峰值；照护者负担上升到透析或移植论坛帖子的 29%。家属撰写的帖子更常表达导航困难和照护者负担。大多数字段与第二家供应商一致（kappa 0.65-0.98）。根据模型标签，家属撰写了 25% 关于肾脏担忧的论坛帖子和 74% 关于透析或移植的帖子；在 139 篇帖子的样本中，医生标签对透析或移植给出 47%-48%（模型为 71%）。【结论】肾脏相关帖子承载情境特异的信息需求以及情绪和实际负担，许多由亲属表达。它们提示了候选应对措施（检查结果解释、饮食支持、面向家庭的信息和支持），这些措施需要评估。关键词：慢性肾脏病；透析；患者体验；照护者；社交媒体；大语言模型

title: Using a large language model as the primary coder in health content analysis: a verification framework, per-variable reliability and proposed reporting items.

summary: 预印本提出LLM主编码的六步验证框架，编码6982条社交平台健康帖并按变量报告信度。

abstract: Objective: To describe and evaluate a framework for using a large language model (LLM) as the primary coder in health content analysis, and to propose reporting items for LLM assisted studies, because no reporting standard exists. Methods: An LLM coded 6,982 Instagram and TikTok posts using a human written, human calibrated instrument. The framework has six components: human authorship of the instrument; two round human calibration; source discipline; quote anchored coding; verification in a representative and an outcome enriched sample, blinded in both directions; and per variable reliability reporting against a prespecified threshold, with the consequence of failure fixed in advance. Agreement was measured with Gwets AC1, prespecified because the outcome distribution was heavily skewed. Results: Agreement between the two human coders on the primary outcome rose from AC1 0.456 to 0.977 after two ambiguous rules were rewritten. LLM human agreement was 0.847 in the representative sample (N = 150) and 0.868 in the enriched sample (N = 50). Five of eight conditional variables fell below the 0.80 threshold and became exploratory: variables asking whether a defined textual feature was present met it, whereas those requiring graded judgement did not. The human coder identified misinformation more often than the LLM, so prevalence estimates are likely underestimates. Agreement on female targeting was lower for self-identified ethnic minority creators (0.744 versus 0.902). Conclusion: LLM coding cannot be computationally reproduced, so its reliability must be shown empirically: per variable agreement with independent human coding, the direction of remaining error, and a prespecified response to shortfall. The authors propose 18 reporting items for LLM assisted content analysis.
zh_abstract: 【目的】描述并评估一个将大语言模型（large language model, LLM）作为健康内容分析主要编码者的框架，并提出针对 LLM 辅助研究的报告条目，因为目前尚无报告标准。【方法】由人工编写并由人工校准的工具被用于让一个 LLM 对 6,982 条 Instagram 和 TikTok 帖子进行编码。该框架包含六个组成部分：工具的人工撰写；两轮人工校准；来源规范；引文锚定编码；在代表性样本和结局富集样本中进行双向盲法验证；以及按预设阈值报告每个变量的信度，并预先固定未达标的后果。一致性使用 Gwets AC1 衡量，因结局分布高度偏斜而预先指定该指标。【结果】在改写两条含糊规则后，两名人类编码者在主要结局上的一致性从 AC1 0.456 升至 0.977。LLM 与人类的一致性在代表性样本（N = 150）中为 0.847，在富集样本（N = 50）中为 0.868。八个条件变量中有五个低于 0.80 阈值并转为探索性：询问某一明确定义的文本特征是否存在的变量达到了阈值，而需要分级判断的变量未达到。人类编码者比 LLM 更常识别出错误信息，因此流行率估计很可能偏低。自我认同为少数族裔的创作者在针对女性受众方面的一致性较低（0.744 对 0.902）。【结论】LLM 编码无法在计算上被复现，因此其信度必须通过实证方式展示：逐变量与独立人工编码的一致性、剩余误差的方向，以及针对未达标情况的预设应对。作者提出 18 条针对 LLM 辅助内容分析的报告条目。

title: Explainability of genotype embedding models through observed cohort paths

summary: 预印本指出，基因型嵌入只在离散等位基因剂量处有定义，因此需在嵌入空间中沿路径归因。

abstract: Deep learning models that combine genotypes with neuroimaging predict neurological diseases more accurately than either modality alone. Their clinical use, however, requires identifying which genetic variants a prediction is based on. Path-based attribution methods like Integrated Gradients address this by integrating the model's gradient from a baseline to the input. These methods assume the model accepts any point along that path as a valid input. Genotype models violate this assumption. They map the three discrete allele dosages \{0,1,2\} to vectors through a learned embedding defined only at those values, so a straight line passes through fractional genotypes at which no embedding, and therefore no gradient, exists. Attribution must therefore proceed in embedding space where the choice of path can affect the resulting attribution. We show that the commonly used per-variant estimator does not generally satisfy completeness. Additive separability guarantees completeness for this estimator, but interactions between variants generally break that property. Instead, we integrate along piecewise-linear embedding-space paths connecting genotype waypoints observed in the training cohort. Each path satisfies completeness in the continuum although the interiors of its segments are not necessarily observed. Our method improves faithfulness over Integrated Gradients and discretized Integrated Gradients under both perturbation protocols, achieves the strongest results for Parkinson's disease classification under support-preserving perturbations, and is competitive with a support-background Shapley baseline under per-variant perturbations. It also shows higher seed stability and better recovery of planted non-additive effects in a synthetic benchmark.
zh_abstract: 将基因型与神经影像结合的深度学习模型，比单独使用任一模态更准确地预测神经系统疾病。然而，其临床使用需要确定预测所依据的是哪些遗传变异。诸如 Integrated Gradients 的基于路径的归因方法通过从基线到输入对模型梯度进行积分来解决这一问题。这些方法假设模型接受该路径上的任意点作为有效输入。基因型模型违反这一假设。它们通过仅在三个离散等位基因剂量 {0,1,2} 处定义的学习嵌入，将这三个值映射为向量，因此直线会经过分数基因型；在这些位置不存在嵌入，因而也不存在梯度。因此，归因必须在嵌入空间中进行，而在嵌入空间中路径的选择可能影响所得归因。我们表明，常用的逐变异估计器通常不满足完备性。可加可分性可保证该估计器满足完备性，但变异之间的交互通常会破坏该性质。作为替代，我们沿连接训练队列中观察到的基因型路点的分段线性嵌入空间路径进行积分。每条路径在连续统中满足完备性，尽管其各段内部不一定被观察到。我们的方法在两种扰动方案下均较 Integrated Gradients 和离散化 Integrated Gradients 提高了忠实性，在保持支撑集的扰动下于帕金森病分类中取得最强结果，并在逐变异扰动下与支持-背景 Shapley 基线具有竞争力。它还在合成基准中表现出更高的随机种子稳定性和对植入的非可加效应更好的恢复能力。

title: QUBO-based feature selection for MRI undersampling pattern design
zh_title: 基于QUBO的MRI欠采样模式特征选择
summary: 预印本将笛卡尔MRI欠采样掩膜设计表述为特征选择，用QUBO模型求解并在fastMRI膝部图像测试。
key_points: 以二值特征表示每条采样线
用互信息与采样数惩罚构造QUBO
模拟退火与量子退火求解，患者分离测试
reason: 预印本新方法，fastMRI患者分离测试但仅重构指标，属值得一看档
abstract: We formulate undersampling mask design for Cartesian magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as a feature subset selection problem. Each sampling line is represented by a binary feature indicating whether it is included in each candidate mask. Using candidate masks and their training-set evaluations, we estimate mutual information (MI) and conditional mutual information (CMI). These estimates and a sampling-count penalty define a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model. The model is solved using simulated annealing and quantum annealing to determine a feature subset and its corresponding sampling mask. We assess the selected subsets on the test set through zero-filled reconstruction in Fourier undersampling simulations using fastMRI knee magnitude reference images, with patient-disjoint training and test sets. At all six tested target sampling rates from 15% to 40%, the resulting reconstructions have lower mean root mean square error than those obtained with four conventional sampling methods. They also have higher mean structural similarity than those obtained using univariate mutual-information ranking at all tested rates. These results support information-theoretic feature selection as an approach to MRI undersampling mask design under the tested zero-filled simulation settings.
zh_abstract: 我们将笛卡尔磁共振成像（MRI）的欠采样掩膜设计表述为特征子集选择问题。每条采样线由一个二值特征表示，该特征指示其是否被包含在每个候选掩膜中。利用候选掩膜及其训练集评估，我们估计互信息（MI）和条件互信息（CMI）。这些估计值和一个采样数惩罚项定义了一个二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）模型。该模型使用模拟退火和量子退火求解，以确定特征子集及其对应的采样掩膜。我们在测试集上通过零填充重建评估所选子集，使用 fastMRI 膝关节幅值参考图像进行傅里叶欠采样模拟，并采用患者不重叠的训练集和测试集。在 15% 至 40% 的全部六个测试目标采样率下，所得重建的平均均方根误差（RMSE）均低于用四种传统采样方法获得的重建。它们还在所有测试采样率下，比使用单变量互信息排序获得的重建具有更高的平均结构相似性（SSIM）。这些结果支持在测试的零填充模拟设置下，将信息论特征选择作为 MRI 欠采样掩膜设计的一种方法。

summary: 预印本提出CALIFUSE，融合多个冻结的病理基础模型，以表征异质性作为不确定性线索。

abstract: Pathology foundation models supply strong representations for whole-slide image classification, yet the confidence attached to their predictions remains hard to trust. Prevailing uncertainty estimators act within a single feature space and thereby overlook the uncertainty that the choice of foundation-model representation itself induces. This work introduces CALIFUSE, a calibration-oriented framework that fuses several pathology foundation models for the specific purpose of uncertainty estimation. Departing from accuracy-driven fusion, CALIFUSE reads representational heterogeneity across encoders as an explicit confidence cue. Slide-level decision consensus is coupled with chunk-level evidence agreement quantified through Jensen-Shannon divergence, so that both prediction stability and fine-grained evidence consistency inform the estimate. Foundation-model encoders stay frozen. A task-specific nnMIL classifier is still trained for each FM; CALIFUSE then estimates confidence at inference without training an extra fusion module. Evaluated on seven WSI classification tasks under several foundation-model combinations, the framework sharpens calibration, misclassification detection, and selective prediction relative to both the strongest single-encoder baseline and naive ensemble averaging, all while preserving competitive balanced accuracy.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型为全切片图像（WSI）分类提供强表征，但其预测所附带的可信度仍难以信任。现有不确定性估计器在单一特征空间内运作，因而忽略了基础模型表征选择本身所引入的不确定性。本工作提出CALIFUSE，一个面向校准的框架，融合多个病理基础模型，专门用于不确定性估计。CALIFUSE不同于以准确性驱动的融合，其将不同编码器之间的表征异质性解读为明确的置信线索。切片级决策共识与通过Jensen-Shannon散度量化的图块级证据一致性相结合，使预测稳定性和细粒度证据一致性共同为估计提供信息。基础模型编码器保持冻结。仍为每个基础模型训练任务特定的nnMIL分类器；CALIFUSE随后在推理时估计置信度，无需训练额外的融合模块。在七项WSI分类任务、若干基础模型组合下评估，该框架相对于最强单编码器基线和朴素集成平均，提升了校准、误分类检测和选择性预测，同时保持有竞争力的平衡准确率。

title: Disentangling Monitor Hardware Artifacts and Smoothing Lag for Shift-Robust Intraoperative EEG and Hemodynamic Risk Calibration

abstract: Commercial intraoperative electroencephalography (EEG) and blood pressure monitors introduce cyclic impedance pulses, smoothing delays, direct-current (DC) drift, and cuff holds that confound risk forecasting and uncertainty calibration. We developed a causal signal-conditioning and shift-robust conformal calibration framework across 5,439 public anesthesia procedures. Streaming filters blank 10.13-min 64-Hz impedance checks, apply unclipped post-notch conditioning, separate 63-s suppression-ratio lag, and distinguish three-channel cuff inflations from dropouts across propofol-remifentanil total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA; N = 3,214), volatile anesthesia (N = 2,046), European endoscopy sedation (N = 171), and DC-coupled surgery (N = 8). De-impedanced cortical tree ensembles were compared against deep sequence models, paired with patient-cluster Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted Conformal Risk Control (CRC) and lag-buffered online Conformal Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) tracking. Pre-filter blanking removed 97.90% and 97.60% of false flatline conflicts while preserving 99.23% and 98.96% of deep suppression. On unseen TIVA surgeries (N = 525), cortical features achieved area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) 0.3135 (1.94% prevalence) and 0.1627 (0.82% lag-free prevalence), with no detectable difference from deep encoders (p >= 0.36) and no cortical gain for hypotension (0.3432 vs. 0.3437, p = 0.784). Zero-retraining volatile transfer (N = 1,048) showed no detectable difference from an end-tidal gas oracle on lag-free suppression (0.0820 vs. 0.0736, p = 0.472). Subgroup-Covariate-Weighted CRC bounded all 70 TIVA shift cells at <= 4.38% (alpha = 5.0%) in 66.32 ms per 30-s epoch. Causal artifact disentangling and shift-aware conformal calibration support reliable real-time intraoperative risk bounds within explicit physiological observability limits.
zh_abstract: 商用术中脑电图（EEG）和血压监测仪会引入周期性阻抗脉冲、平滑延迟、直流（DC）漂移和袖带保持，这些会干扰风险预测和不确定性校准。我们在5,439例公开麻醉操作中开发了一个因果信号调理和位移稳健的共形校准框架。流式滤波器屏蔽10.13分钟、64 Hz的阻抗检查，应用未削波的陷波后调理，分离63秒的抑制比滞后，并在丙泊酚-瑞芬太尼全静脉麻醉（TIVA；N=3,214）、挥发性麻醉（N=2,046）、欧洲内镜镇静（N=171）和DC耦合手术（N=8）中区分三通道袖带充气与信号脱落。去阻抗后的皮层树集成模型与深度序列模型进行比较，并配以患者簇的亚组-协变量加权共形风险控制（CRC）和带滞后缓冲的在线共形比例-积分-微分（PID）跟踪。滤波前置空去除了97.90%和97.60%的假性平线冲突，同时保留了99.23%和98.96%的深度抑制。在未见过的TIVA手术（N=525）中，皮层特征达到精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）0.3135（患病率1.94%）和0.1627（无滞后患病率0.82%），与深度编码器相比未检测到差异（p ≥ 0.36），对低血压未显示皮层增益（0.3432 vs. 0.3437，p=0.784）。零重训练挥发性麻醉迁移（N=1,048）在无滞后抑制方面与呼气末气体oracle相比未检测到差异（0.0820 vs. 0.0736，p=0.472）。亚组-协变量加权CRC将所有70个TIVA偏移单元的界限控制在≤4.38%（α=5.0%），每个30秒epoch耗时66.32 ms。因果伪差解缠和位移感知共形校准在明确的生理可观测性限制内支持可靠的实时术中风险界限。

title: PAIR-MED: Policy-reward Alternation for Iterative Refinement in Multilingual Medical Reasoning

summary: 提出策略—奖励交替训练框架，让医学过程奖励模型随策略轨迹更新，以改进多语言医学推理的强化学习监督。

abstract: Large language models demonstrate strong medical question-answering capabilities, yet reasoning performance remains uneven across languages. Process reward models (PRMs) provide step-level feedback for improving reasoning, but a fixed PRM may become increasingly misaligned with the trajectory distribution of an evolving policy during reinforcement learning, thereby reducing the reliability of its supervision. We propose a policy--reward alternating training framework that jointly adapts a medical PRM and optimizes a multilingual reasoning policy. Following supervised initialization, the current policy generates multilingual trajectories to update the PRM, which then provides process-level rewards for the next policy update. Medical step supervision maintains the PRM's medical foundation, while process, outcome, and language-related rewards guide policy learning. We develop multilingual medical PRMs (PAIR-PRM) and reasoning models (PAIR-MED) at 8B and 9B scales across 12 languages. On the medical subsets of Global-MMLU and MMLU-ProX, our models improve average accuracy by 3.01--7.47% over their corresponding Qwen backbones. On CUREMED-BENCH, PAIR-MED-9B improves the joint language consistency and logical accuracy metric by 12.88% and 7.45% over baselines for in-domain and out-of-domain languages. Further analyses examine PRM adaptation, multilingual reasoning quality, and the contributions of individual training components.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型在医学问答方面展现出强大能力，但其推理性能在不同语言之间仍不均衡。过程奖励模型（process reward models, PRMs）为改进推理提供步骤级反馈，但固定的PRM在强化学习过程中可能日益偏离不断演化的策略的轨迹分布，从而降低其监督的可靠性。我们提出一种策略—奖励交替训练框架，联合适配医学PRM并优化多语言推理策略。在监督初始化之后，当前策略生成多语言轨迹以更新PRM，随后PRM为下一次策略更新提供过程级奖励。医学步骤监督维持PRM的医学基础，而过程、结果和语言相关奖励引导策略学习。我们开发了覆盖12种语言、8B和9B规模的多语言医学PRM（PAIR-PRM）和推理模型（PAIR-MED）。在Global-MMLU和MMLU-ProX的医学子集上，我们的模型相比对应的Qwen骨干模型将平均准确率提高3.01--7.47%。在CUREMED-BENCH上，PAIR-MED-9B在域内和域外语言上相比基线将联合语言一致性与逻辑准确性指标分别提高12.88%和7.45%。进一步分析考察了PRM适配、多语言推理质量以及各个训练组件的贡献。

abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is an aggressive and heterogeneous subtype of breast cancer with limited targeted therapies and poor prognosis. Recent advances in digital pathology and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming traditional, qualitative histopathology into quantitative, data-driven analysis. Within computational pathology, pathomics (the extraction of handcrafted, high-dimensional features from digitized histological images) and deep learning (DL)-based whole-slide image analysis have been investigated for the prediction of molecular subtypes, biomarker expression, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and treatment response in TNBC. AI models, including DL and multimodal systems integrating histopathology, omics, and clinical data, are being explored for patient stratification, risk assessment, and therapy personalization, encompassing chemotherapy, immunotherapy, PARP inhibitors, and antibody-drug conjugates. By linking spatial tissue architecture with molecular profiles, these approaches may provide new insights into tumor biology and the tumor microenvironment. Most TNBC-specific studies are retrospective, small or single-center, few have been externally validated and, to our knowledge, none has yet demonstrated clinical utility in prospective trials; prediction of biomarkers such as PD-L1 or homologous recombination deficiency from hematoxylin and eosin slides remains investigational and cannot replace validated testing. Despite these challenges, AI-assisted computational pathology is a promising decision-support tool, which complements and does not replace pathologists and oncologists, for enhancing diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision-making in TNBC.

abstract: [Frontiers in endocrinology] Thyroid cancer is one of the most common endocrine malignancies, and its rising incidence has increased the demand for more accurate and efficient diagnostic and management strategies. Current clinical management mainly relies on ultrasonography, fine-needle aspiration (FNA), surgery, radioactive iodine therapy, thyroid-stimulating hormone suppression, and systemic treatment in selected advanced cases. However, substantial interobserver variability, indeterminate cytology, and heterogeneity in tumor behavior still complicate diagnosis and risk stratification. In thyroid cancer, AI(Artificial intelligence) -assisted models have been applied to ultrasound, CT, MRI, cytology, histopathology, and genomic data, with promising performance in distinguishing benign from malignant nodules, predicting lymph node metastasis and key mutations, and supporting individualized management. This review critically synthesizes evidence across these applications, focusing on study design, validation strategies, generalizability, and clinical relevance. It also examines explainable AI, emerging foundation models, and regulatory and implementation challenges. Although many models report high diagnostic or predictive performance, these results alone do not establish improvements in clinical decision-making or patient outcomes. Prospective clinical validation, cost-effectiveness assessment, and evaluation of integration into clinical workflows are needed to determine whether AI provides meaningful benefits over standard care.

abstract: [Nurse education in practice] Based on a systematically screened corpus of literature, this bibliometric study aims to map the research landscape and hotspots of artificial intelligence (AI) in nursing education from 2022 to 2026 and provide evidence-based guidance for future research and educational practice. The rapid integration of AI and digital transformation is fundamentally reshaping nursing education, yet a comprehensive, up-to-date overview of its research landscape remains lacking. Bibliometric and content analysis. Publications were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (January 2022-June 2026). Using CiteSpace 6.4.R1, co-occurrence, cluster, burst and timeline analyses were performed to visualize the knowledge structure and identify emerging research frontiers. A total of 409 publications were included, with output surging in 2025 and most papers appearing in JCR Q1/Q2 journals. The United States, China and Türkiye led output, but cross-national and cross-institutional collaboration remained sparse. Three predominant research clusters were identified: applications of AI in nursing education, attitudes and readiness of nursing students and educators toward AI and capacity building for AI implementation. The field is expanding rapidly yet remains fragmented and exploratory. Three priorities are proposed: guiding technology adoption by the competencies curricula intend to develop rather than technological novelty; treating readiness as a dynamic construct and shifting assessment toward process-oriented evidence; and positioning capacity building-tiered AI literacy and faculty development, curriculum integration and ethical and policy-oriented governance-as a safeguard for sustainable AI integration. Strengthening international collaboration will underpin these priorities.

abstract: Accurately predicting cancer drug response remains a major challenge in precision oncology. Although some therapies are guided by clinically-approved biomarkers, these markers often yield limited predictive value and are unavailable for many drugs. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning approaches trained on large-scale cancer cell line pharmacogenomic screens offer a promising route to more comprehensive response prediction, yet they generally assume that phenotypic readouts are measured without error. This assumption is problematic because viability-based drug response assays are inherently noisy, potentially causing models to learn experimental artefacts rather than biologically meaningful determinants of sensitivity. Here, we show that phenotypic measurement noise is present in four widely used cancer cell line screening datasets and introduce Deep Concordance Index Networks (DeepCINET), a deep learning framework that explicitly accounts for this noise. Across datasets, incorporating this noise-aware ranking strategy improves generalization across experimental conditions and to previously unseen samples. DeepCINET outperforms baseline models in multiple settings, with particularly notable gains in prioritizing the most drug-sensitive cell lines. Together, these results establish phenotypic assay noise as a critical and previously overlooked source of error in drug response modelling and provide a principled framework for noise-aware multivariable biomarker discovery.
zh_abstract: 准确预测癌症药物反应仍是精准肿瘤学中的一大挑战。尽管部分治疗由临床批准的生物标志物指导，但这些标志物通常预测价值有限，且在许多药物中不可用。基于大规模癌细胞系药物基因组学筛选训练的人工智能与机器学习方法，为更全面的反应预测提供了有前景的途径，然而它们通常假设表型读出是在无误差情况下测量的。这一假设存在问题，因为基于活力的药物反应测定本身具有噪声，可能导致模型学习到实验伪影，而非具有生物学意义的敏感性决定因素。在此，我们表明四个广泛使用的癌细胞系筛选数据集中存在表型测量噪声，并引入深度一致性指数网络（Deep Concordance Index Networks, DeepCINET），这是一个明确考虑该噪声的深度学习框架。在各数据集中，纳入这种噪声感知排序策略改善了跨实验条件以及对先前未见样本的泛化。DeepCINET在多种设置下优于基线模型，在优先识别最药物敏感的细胞系方面尤其取得显著增益。总之，这些结果确立了表型测定噪声是药物反应建模中一个关键且此前被忽视的误差来源，并为噪声感知的多变量生物标志物发现提供了原则性框架。

title: A Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble Framework for Privacy-Preserving Mortality Prediction Across Heterogeneous Healthcare Systems
zh_title: 区块链联邦集成框架实现跨机构隐私保护死亡预测

abstract: Objective: To test whether a smart contract that admits hospital-trained models to a shared mortality model only after peer hospitals verify their performance can exclude poisoned or substituted models, and at what cost. Design: Retrospective simulation study of a federated learning protocol. Methodology: In the Blockchain-Enabled Federated Ensemble (BFE), hospitals committed SHA-256 digests of locally trained XGBoost and random-forest models to a Solidity contract; peers posted digest-bound validation AUROCs, and the contract admitted models with a median peer AUROC of at least 0.70. Admitted models were pooled by weighted logit averaging (BFE-PW) or stacking (BFE-Stack) with federated recalibration. Code and drafts were produced with an AI coding assistant under the authors' supervision. Setting: Four hospitals simulated from one academic centre with age, renal case-mix and laboratory-availability skew; a data-scarce regime keeping 5-20% of each hospital's patients; and a natural partition by care era. Participants: 425,215 adult admissions (186,103 patients; 2.35% in-hospital mortality) in MIMIC-IV v3.1, with predictors from the first 24 hours. Interventions: BFE against centralised, local-only, FedAvg, FedProx, median and Multi-Krum FedAvg and federated logistic regression, under seven attacks on training, attestation, recalibration and model delivery. Main outcome measures: AUROC and AUPRC (joint patient-clustered bootstrap), calibration, attack effects, gas and transactions. Results: Under gross label flipping, FedAvg lost 29% of its AUPRC while the contract excluded the poisoned models in every seed (Multi-Krum FedAvg was equally protected); all substituted models were detected, and collusion blocked release. A targeted flip of female deaths passed the gate and lowered sensitivity for deaths in women from 32.8% to 27.5%; poisoned recalibration inverted BFE-PW (AUROC 0.098) unless a median-of-sites recalibration was used (0.902). With large hospitals, BFE-PW matched FedAvg in AUROC (0.902) and BFE-Stack matched FedProx (0.907 and 0.906), below local-only (0.910) and centralised XGBoost (0.915), with lower AUPRC; with 5% of the data, BFE-PW exceeded local models (0.866 against 0.844). Pooled calibration hid two-fold under-prediction at one hospital (observed-to-expected ratio 2.13), which a local intercept corrected (0.93). One aggregation used 37 transactions and 3.3 million gas, rising roughly quadratically with consortium size. Conclusions: Contrac

title: Improving Target-Adverse Event Association Prediction via Inverse Node Frequency Transformation to Mitigate Knowledge Graph Topological Bias

abstract: Motivation: Identifying significant associations between therapeutic protein targets and adverse events (AEs) is a critical component of drug safety assessment. To accelerate the process, machine learning methods have been developed to predict these associations as edges in network data integrating molecular interactions and other key biomedical knowledge. However, these networks often suffer from topological imbalances where a minority of "hub" nodes determine the predictive signal. This "topological" or "degree bias" can lead to poor performance on novel or understudied targets where safety inference is most needed. Results: We introduce Inverse Node Frequency (INF), a generally applicable node degree-based approach for mitigating topological bias. Employing an enriched biomedical knowledge graph and our own carefully curated target-adverse event associations, we apply INF as a normalisation procedure on a class of graph-derived features called metapaths and evaluate their resulting target-AE association prediction performance. Our results demonstrate that INF significantly improves the true positive rate (TPR/recall) for low-degree targets compared to the untransformed metapath features as well as a popular established normalisation method, while also achieving highly competitive hits@k, a ranking-based metric for knowledge graph-based inference. We also evaluated INF on an external set of target-AE associations never before used for modelling, on which INF also showed superior resilience compared to the two benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 【动机】识别治疗性蛋白靶点与不良事件（AEs）之间的显著关联是药物安全性评估的关键组成部分。为加速这一过程，已开发机器学习方法，将整合分子相互作用和其他关键生物医学知识的网络数据中的这些关联作为边进行预测。然而，这些网络常存在拓扑不平衡，即少数“枢纽”（hub）节点决定预测信号。这种“拓扑”或“度”偏倚（degree bias）可能导致在新型或研究不足、最需要安全性推断的靶点上性能不佳。【结果】我们提出逆节点频率（Inverse Node Frequency, INF），一种可普遍应用的、基于节点度的方法，用于缓解拓扑偏倚。利用一个丰富的生物医学知识图谱和我们精心整理的目标-不良事件关联，我们将 INF 作为一种归一化程序应用于一类称为元路径（metapaths）的图衍生特征，并评估其由此产生的目标-AE 关联预测性能。我们的结果表明，与未变换的元路径特征以及一种流行的既有归一化方法相比，INF 显著提高了低度靶点的真阳性率（TPR/召回率），同时也在 hits@k（一种基于知识图谱推断的排序指标）上取得极具竞争力的表现。我们还在一个此前从未用于建模的外部目标-AE 关联集上评估了 INF，在该集合上 INF 也显示出优于两个基准的韧性。

abstract: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions. Thermal imaging offers a promising contactless alternative to traditional methods, which often rely on partially invasive sensors or obtrusive wearable systems. However, existing approaches for $f_R$ estimation from thermal signals typically require extensive pre-processing and manual or semi-automatic region-of-interest (ROI) tracking, limiting their practical applicability. This study proposes a deep learning-based method for estimating $f_R$ directly from thermal videos, eliminating the need for complex pre-processing and ROI tracking. A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) is developed to operate on raw thermal video data. To address challenges related to small datasets, the model is trained using data augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a validation $R^2$ score of approximately 0.61 on both pre-processed and raw thermal videos. By simplifying the workflow, this method holds promise for enhancing the feasibility of thermal imaging in real-world applications, such as remote healthcare and driver monitoring in automotive applications.
zh_abstract: 监测呼吸频率（$f_R$）等生理参数对于诊断和管理多种病理状况至关重要。热成像为传统方法提供了一种有前景的非接触式替代方案，传统方法往往依赖部分侵入式传感器或妨碍性的可穿戴系统。然而，现有从热信号估计$f_R$的方法通常需要大量预处理以及手动或半自动的兴趣区域（ROI）跟踪，限制了其实际适用性。本研究提出一种基于深度学习的方法，可直接从热视频估计$f_R$，无需复杂预处理和ROI跟踪。开发了一个3D卷积神经网络（3D-CNN）以处理原始热视频数据。为应对小数据集相关挑战，模型使用数据增强和来自合成数据集的迁移学习进行训练。实验结果表明，所提方法在预处理后和原始热视频上均达到约0.61的验证$R^2$评分。通过简化工作流程，该方法有望增强热成像在现实应用中的可行性，例如远程医疗保健和汽车应用中的驾驶员监测。

title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
zh_title: 不确定性条件化推理：从序列不确定性到表型假设
summary: arXiv 预印本提出不确定性条件化路径能量框架，将基因组模型变异预测及其不确定性转为知识图谱支持的表型假设分布。
key_points: 无需患者层面表型监督
以可解释能量评分基因-疾病-表型路径

abstract: Genomic foundation models provide variant-level evidence, but connecting that evidence to phenotype hypotheses requires accounting for uncertainty throughout structured reasoning. We introduce an uncertainty-conditioned path-energy framework that converts sequence predictions and calibrated predictive uncertainty into explicit distributions over graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, without patient-level phenotype supervision. An interpretable learned energy scores admissible gene--disease--phenotype routes, query uncertainty controls the target temperature, and path probabilities are aggregated into phenotype hypotheses. This formulation makes evidence quality an explicit determinant of hypothesis breadth while retaining traceable multi-path support. Exact normalization over enumerable candidate sets provides a reference for evaluating a Hastings-corrected learned revision operator. On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype-level entropy tracks upstream uncertainty, with Spearman correlations of 0.951 and 0.878, respectively; ablations identify the contribution of uncertainty conditioning. In masked-edge recovery, the model exceeds chance and degree-matched probability-permutation controls. Training the energy under the uncertainty-dependent temperature yields higher held-out recall@10 than training under a constant temperature of comparable magnitude. Under gene hold-out, recall@10 exceeds that of a trained DistMult embedding on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123); this difference is attributable mainly to three genes with many variants and is not established for all genes. These results establish an uncertainty-aware interface from genomic predictions to graph-supported phenotype hypotheses that combines interpretable probability allocation with held-out association recovery of explicitly stated scope.
zh_abstract: 基因组基础模型提供变异级证据，但要将该证据与表型假设联系起来，需要在结构化推理全程考虑不确定性。我们引入一种不确定性条件化的路径能量框架，该框架无需患者级表型监督，即可将序列预测和校准后的预测不确定性转换为图支持的表型假设上的显式分布。一个可解释的学习能量为可接受的基因–疾病–表型路线打分，查询不确定性控制目标温度，路径概率被聚合为表型假设。该表述使证据质量成为假设广度的显式决定因素，同时保留可追踪的多路径支持。对可枚举候选集的精确归一化为评估经 Hastings 校正的学习型修正算子提供了参考。在 AlzKB 和 Hetionet 上，表型级熵追踪上游不确定性，Spearman 相关系数分别为 0.951 和 0.878；消融实验识别了不确定性条件化的贡献。在掩蔽边恢复中，模型超过随机水平和度匹配的概率置换对照。在不确定性依赖的温度下训练能量，比在量级相当的恒定温度下训练获得更高的留出 recall@10。在基因留出下，recall@10 在 30 个图掩码中的 24 个上超过训练过的 DistMult 嵌入（0.183 对 0.123）；这一差异主要归因于三个具有许多变异的基因，并且并非对所有基因都成立。这些结果建立了一个从基因组预测到图支持的表型假设的不确定性感知接口，该接口将可解释的概率分配与明确所述范围的留出关联恢复相结合。

title: Statistical, Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Missing Covariates: An Empirical Evaluation with Applications to Alzheimer's Disease Research

summary: 预印本：在阿尔茨海默病场景下实证比较八种缺失协变量处理方法，涵盖传统插补与多种深度生成模型。

覆盖MLP、变分自编码器与生成对抗网络
